en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a slightly uphill cobblestone street lined with two- and three-story houses and small town buildings. A woman in traditional dress walks on the right sidewalk. The architecture is late 19th to early 20th century Central European. At the top margin there is printed text identifying the view as a street in Rumburg in Bohemia, specifically Elisabethgasse.
